scenarios.title: A｜直接找同事谈
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现同事 Chris 向领导汇报时，把玩家提出的方案说成了自己的想法。会议结束后，玩家私下找到他。

turns.prompt: 你想找同事谈谈会议中让你在意的事情，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, can we talk about what happened in the meeting?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, can we talk about what happened in the meeting?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: I wanted to ask you about something you said earlier.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted to ask you about something you said earlier.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: Do you have a minute? There’s something I’d like to clear up.

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a minute? There’s something I’d like to clear up.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I think we need to talk about how that idea was presented.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we need to talk about how that idea was presented.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Why did you steal my idea?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, can we talk about what happened in the meeting?
feedback.explanation: “steal”预设对方故意盗用；先说明自己何时提出过这个想法，再要求澄清贡献，更有依据。

turns.prompt: 关于「同事抢走自己的功劳」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: The idea you presented was the one I proposed last week.

feedback.naturalExpression: The idea you presented was the one I proposed last week.
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: When you presented the idea, it sounded like you were taking full credit for it.

feedback.naturalExpression: When you presented the idea, it sounded like you were taking full credit for it.
feedback.explanation: “full credit”指全部功劳；谈协作时用它说明贡献归属的问题。

choices.text: I was surprised you didn’t mention that we’d worked on it together.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was surprised you didn’t mention that we’d worked on it together.
feedback.explanation: “I was surprised”从自己的反应切入，说明为什么想进一步了解事情。

choices.text: I don’t mind you presenting it, but I’d like my contribution to be acknowledged.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t mind you presenting it, but I’d like my contribution to be acknowledged.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

turns.text: I wasn’t trying to take credit. I thought we were presenting it as a team idea.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand, but that’s not how it came across in the meeting.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but that’s not how it came across in the meeting.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: If it’s a team idea, then I’d like both of us to be credited.

feedback.naturalExpression: If it’s a team idea, then I’d like both of us to be credited.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Okay. Then can we make that clearer next time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Then can we make that clearer next time?
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。

choices.text: I’m glad to hear that. I just didn’t want there to be a misunderstanding.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m glad to hear that. I just didn’t want there to be a misunderstanding.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

turns.text: That’s fair. I’ll make sure I mention your contribution next time.

turns.prompt: 你已经了解所需信息，想表达感谢并结束交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. That’s all I wanted.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. That’s all I wanted.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: I appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

scenarios.title: B｜在会议中澄清
scenarios.setting: 领导正在讨论 Chris 刚刚介绍的方案。玩家需要在不直接制造冲突的情况下说明自己的参与。

turns.text: Chris, I really like this approach. How did you come up with it?
I was looking at the problem last week and thought this might work.

turns.prompt: 你想补充这项想法的合作背景，会怎么说？

choices.text: Just to add some context, Chris and I discussed this approach together last week.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to add some context, Chris and I discussed this approach together last week.
feedback.explanation: “last week”表示过去的时间段，前面通常不加介词。

choices.text: I’d also like to add that this came out of some work I did on the issue last week.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d also like to add that this came out of some work I did on the issue last week.
feedback.explanation: “last week”表示过去的时间段，前面通常不加介词。

choices.text: Chris and I actually worked through the original idea together.

feedback.naturalExpression: Chris and I actually worked through the original idea together.
feedback.explanation: “original”指原件或原始版本；与复印件、修改版区分。

choices.text: I’m glad the idea is working. I originally suggested it when we were reviewing the problem last week.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m glad the idea is working. I originally suggested it when we were reviewing the problem last week.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Actually, this was my idea, not his.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Just to add some context, Chris and I discussed this approach together last week.
feedback.explanation: 这句可以澄清归属，但公开强调“not his”较对抗；具体补充自己的贡献更便于核实。

turns.text: Oh, I see. So you both worked on it?

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己和同事各自的贡献，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. I came up with the initial approach, and Chris helped develop it further.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I came up with the initial approach, and Chris helped develop it further.
feedback.explanation: “came up with”表示想出主意或方案，谈创意归属时能点明贡献。

choices.text: That’s right. We both contributed to the final version.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s right. We both contributed to the final version.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: Yes. I did the initial analysis, and then we worked on the solution together.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I did the initial analysis, and then we worked on the solution together.
feedback.explanation: “together”强调双方一起参与或同处一处，适合商量共同安排。

turns.text: Yeah, that’s right. Alex did the early work on it.

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: Exactly. And I think the current version is stronger because of both our input.

feedback.naturalExpression: Exactly. And I think the current version is stronger because of both our input.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: Right. I’m happy with where we ended up.

feedback.naturalExpression: Right. I’m happy with where we ended up.
feedback.explanation: “I'm happy”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

scenarios.title: C｜向领导说明
scenarios.setting: 类似情况已经发生不止一次，玩家决定私下和领导谈。

turns.text: You wanted to talk to me?

turns.prompt: 关于「同事抢走自己的功劳」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Yes. There’s something about the project I’d like to discuss with you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. There’s something about the project I’d like to discuss with you.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I wanted to clarify my role in some of the recent work.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wanted to clarify my role in some of the recent work.
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: There’s been some confusion about who’s responsible for certain parts of the project.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s been some confusion about who’s responsible for certain parts of the project.
feedback.explanation: “responsible for”表示负责某项工作，能用来确认任务归属。

choices.text: I’d like to talk about how my contributions have been communicated.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to talk about how my contributions have been communicated.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

turns.prompt: 你想向领导说明贡献未被提及的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve noticed that some of my work has been presented without my contribution being mentioned.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve noticed that some of my work has been presented without my contribution being mentioned.
feedback.explanation: “has been”把过去开始的状态与现在联系起来，常用于说明持续情况或经历。

choices.text: I’ve done a significant part of the work, but that hasn’t always been clear in meetings.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve done a significant part of the work, but that hasn’t always been clear in meetings.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: I’m concerned that there’s a gap between the work I’m doing and how it’s being represented.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m concerned that there’s a gap between the work I’m doing and how it’s being represented.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

choices.text: I don’t want to create conflict, but this has happened more than once.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to create conflict, but this has happened more than once.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t want to”明确表达自己的意愿或界限，后面的具体动作说明拒绝的是哪件事。

turns.text: Can you give me an example?

turns.prompt: 你想说明日期、时长或时间上的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. The proposal from Tuesday’s meeting was based on the analysis I completed last week.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. The proposal from Tuesday’s meeting was based on the analysis I completed last week.
feedback.explanation: “last week”表示过去的时间段，前面通常不加介词。

choices.text: Yes. I have the earlier drafts and messages showing how the idea developed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I have the earlier drafts and messages showing how the idea developed.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I can walk you through which parts I was responsible for.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can walk you through which parts I was responsible for.
feedback.explanation: “responsible for”表示负责某项工作，能用来确认任务归属。

turns.text: Okay. Thanks for bringing this to my attention.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks for hearing me out. I mainly want my work to be represented accurately.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for hearing me out. I mainly want my work to be represented accurately.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: I appreciate it. I’d just like expectations and responsibilities to be clearer going forward.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate it. I’d just like expectations and responsibilities to be clearer going forward.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。
